purpose: Mentor-requested sensitivity of the site GNN to spatial neighborhood size
model_selection_reason: One-layer GNN had higher recall than two-layer GNN in the previously inspected development comparison. This choice is developmental, not independent of those results.
query_radius_and_edge_radius: Changed together to each specified radius; does not independently identify the effect of edge connectivity versus visible context
query_execution: Retain all observed window nodes and all causal incoming edges to the query. For a one-layer network only, non-query destination edges have no computational path to the query output. Validate against full induced-graph logits, gradients and Adam updates.
causality: Same endcap; t-7 through t inclusive; current bin must close; known simulated event boundaries retained in this development branch
node_inputs: One constant occupancy feature; no labels, charge truth, track identity, absolute position or event identity enter the model
historical_reference_note: Prior fits changed numerical execution during recovery. All nine radius fits start fresh using the same implementation for comparability; no claim of bitwise reproduction of historical training.
control_count_radii: R/4, R/2, R; query excluded; eight-bin history and same endcap
control_fit: Original training-only scaler and class-balanced L-BFGS logistic fit with fixed L2=0.01; one deterministic fit per control/radius
optimizer: Original Adam lr=0.001, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, no weight decay, clip gradient norm=1
loss: Original class-balanced BCE and fixed denominator; ignored query targets masked; all truth roles remain available as observable context
orders: Original frozen epoch orders and seeds
checkpoint_selection: Earliest strict minimum development validation class-balanced BCE
primary_endpoints: Equal-event mean microcurler-site recall over microcurler-bearing events
Pooled primary-charge retention including primary charge at ignored sites
Fraction of primary-bearing events losing strictly more than 5 percent of their own primary charge
threshold_scope: Descriptive development validation; whole logit ties retained, no independent confirmation or deployment threshold choice
uncertainty: Show all three neural seeds and full range; deterministic controls have no seed replicate range
secondary_endpoints: Graph construction and model processing cost
detector_upgrade_status: On hold pending Tanner's transport response
